note: Seed set. Reach bands are order-of-magnitude buckets (S <1M, M 1-10M, L 10-50M, XL 50M+) meant for ranking, not reporting. Verify before quoting.

surfaces.name: Moneycontrol
surfaces.wayIn: Pitch a tool that keeps users on-page longer (calculators, trackers). Editorial + product teams both need engagement.

surfaces.name: Livemint
surfaces.wayIn: Explainer content + embedded tools under Money/Personal Finance sections.

surfaces.name: Inshorts
surfaces.wayIn: Native card formats; pitch a daily utility card, not an ad.

surfaces.name: ET Markets
surfaces.wayIn: Market tools and screeners; partnerships desk is active.

surfaces.name: PhonePe
surfaces.wayIn: PhonePe Switch / mini-app marketplace; needs a transactional use case.

surfaces.name: Paytm
surfaces.wayIn: Mini-app store; strong for merchant-side products.

surfaces.name: Google Pay (India)
surfaces.wayIn: Spot experiences; long approval cycle, high reach.

surfaces.name: CRED
surfaces.wayIn: CRED Store / member offers; premium positioning required.

surfaces.name: Zerodha Varsity
surfaces.wayIn: Guest modules and tool references; credibility over reach.

surfaces.name: WhatsApp Communities
surfaces.wayIn: Business API bots and admin-run communities; retention channel more than acquisition.

surfaces.name: Telegram finance channels
surfaces.wayIn: Sponsor or run a utility bot; be careful with compliance.

surfaces.name: YouTube finance creators
surfaces.wayIn: Tool integrations inside creator content; SEBI ad-code rules apply.

surfaces.name: ShareChat / Moj
surfaces.wayIn: Vernacular creator programs; low finance intent, high reach.

surfaces.name: LinkedIn India
surfaces.wayIn: Founder-led content and newsletters; best for B2B and salaried personas.

surfaces.name: Reddit (r/IndiaInvestments etc.)
surfaces.wayIn: Earn trust with transparent tools; no shilling.

surfaces.name: Swiggy / Zomato
surfaces.wayIn: Cross-sell surfaces and loyalty tie-ins; hard to get, huge if landed.

surfaces.name: Employer HR / payroll portals
surfaces.wayIn: Distribute via payroll and benefits providers; one deal = thousands of users.

surfaces.name: MF platforms (Groww, Kuvera, Coin)
surfaces.wayIn: Complementary tools, not competing ones.

surfaces.name: Jio ecosystem (MyJio)
surfaces.wayIn: Enterprise partnership route; long cycle.

surfaces.name: College clubs and placement cells
surfaces.wayIn: Campus ambassador programs; cheap, slow, loyal.
